title: Test — Story Board
body:
A short three-act demo for the Story Board feature — a `[!story-board]` callout containing plain GFM tables (Nodes + Edges), rendered here as an interactive planning canvas. Toggle between Swimlane and Freeform mode from the board's own toolbar, drag nodes around, promote a placeholder to a real reference, or hand-edit the tables directly and reload — either editing path round-trips through the same markdown.

> [!story-board]+ The Smuggler's Bargain
> Layout: swimlane
> Lanes: The Investigation, The Smugglers, Berosalia's Secret
> Stages: Act 1, Act 2, Act 3
>
> | Node                     | Type        | Ref                             | Lane               | Stage | X   | Y   | Color  |
> | ------------------------ | ----------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------ | ----- | --- | --- | ------ |
> | The Shipment Vanishes    | ref         | quest:Find the Missing Shipment | The Investigation  | Act 1 | 100 | 80  |        |
> | Dockside Rumors          | placeholder |                                 | The Investigation  | Act 1 | 300 | 80  |        |
> | Smugglers' Signal        | placeholder |                                 | The Smugglers      | Act 1 | 100 | 220 | blue   |
> | Berosalia's Warning      | ref         | npc:Berosalia Hart              | Berosalia's Secret | Act 1 | 100 | 360 |        |
> | Confrontation at Duskvol | ref         | location:Duskvol                | The Investigation  | Act 2 | 300 | 80  |        |
> | The Smugglers' Ultimatum | placeholder |                                 | The Smugglers      | Act 2 | 300 | 220 | orange |
> | Berosalia's True Loyalty | placeholder |                                 | Berosalia's Secret | Act 2 | 300 | 360 | purple |
> | Showdown on the Docks    | ref         | quest:Secure Passage to Duskvol | The Investigation  | Act 3 | 500 | 80  |        |
> | The Deal is Struck       | placeholder |                                 | The Smugglers      | Act 3 | 500 | 220 |        |
>
> | From                     | To                       | Label      |
> | ------------------------ | ------------------------ | ---------- |
> | The Shipment Vanishes    | Dockside Rumors          | leads to   |
> | Dockside Rumors          | Smugglers' Signal        | reveals    |
> | Smugglers' Signal        | Berosalia's Warning      | implicates |
> | Berosalia's Warning      | Confrontation at Duskvol | leads to   |
> | Confrontation at Duskvol | The Smugglers' Ultimatum | escalates  |
> | The Smugglers' Ultimatum | Berosalia's True Loyalty | tests      |
> | Berosalia's True Loyalty | Showdown on the Docks    | leads to   |
> | The Smugglers' Ultimatum | The Deal is Struck       | resolves   |

The two `ref` nodes tagged `quest:` above resolve to the quests on [[Test — Quests]]; `npc:Berosalia Hart` and `location:Duskvol` resolve to real Library entries. Every other node is a `placeholder` — try using the node inspector's "Promote to real content" action on one of them.
